title: Unrecognised charge
summary: Customer reports a charge she doesn't recognise. Ends in a dispute case.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Everyday Bank, this is Sam. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Sam. There's a charge on my card that I don't recognise.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with that. Can you tell me a bit about the charge?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's about a hundred and thirty dollars, from something called Nova Digital. Last week, I think.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did you sign up for anything new with them recently?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, never. I only have their basic plan, and that's like thirteen dollars a month. I still have my card with me.
